title: Pan-Seared Polish Pork Chops
description: Tender and juicy pork chops seared to perfection in a skillet. A delicious and easy dinner recipe.
instructions: Season pork chops with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat.
Sear pork chops for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Reduce heat to medium-low and continue cooking for an additional 5 minutes, or until cooked through.
Let pork chops rest for a few minutes before serving.
